verdict.rationale: Docs show card spend limits can be adjusted instantly by an admin/finance-lead through the platform ('Adjust spend limits instantly', 'Spend Limits: Cap employees' spend with card controls and custom limits') and even via the MCP/API layer, which supports self-service limit changes. However, none of the evidence describes a dedicated 'request/approval' self-service screen specifically for transaction limit increases, only general spend-limit controls. Missing for 10: a documented request/approval workflow UI, independent/hands-on confirmation, and explicit framing of 'finance-lead requesting an increase' rather than just admin-set limits.
